description: This file implements serialization and deserialization functions for TPM2 data structures, including marshalling and unmarshalling logic, using the TSS2 library. It defines a template class TpmSerializable for handling TPM2B_PRIVATE and TPM2B_PUBLIC structures.

classes.name: TpmSerializable
classes.description: A template class for serializing and deserializing TPM2 structures such as TPM2B_PRIVATE and TPM2B_PUBLIC.

methods.name: TpmSerializable<T>::TpmSerializable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the instance pointer.

methods.name: TpmSerializable<T>::SerializedSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the serialized TPM2 structure.

methods.name: TpmSerializable<T>::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the TPM2 structure into a buffer.

methods.name: TpmSerializable<T>::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer into the TPM2 structure.
